narrative.heading: A clinical and research approach
narrative.text: Tiffany C. Scharschmidt describes her work as spanning dermatology, microbiology and immunology. In her named lab profile, she says she devotes 80% of her time to research and the rest to caring for patients with severe inflammatory skin disease; her lab studies interactions between bacteria and the developing immune system using human skin, blood and microbiome samples alongside model systems. UCSF Health also describes her adult dermatology care and work overseeing multidisciplinary care for complex skin disease. These are her institutionally published descriptions of a distinctive research-and-clinical approach, not claims of patient outcomes or independent credential verification.
